blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Modern text-to-image (T2I) models generate high-quality images from arbitrary user prompts, yet they can just as easily produce not-safe-for-work (NSFW) content. Conventional outer guardrails consist of two components: a prompt classifier that checks for risk before generation, and a post-hoc image classifier that checks the fully generated image. In this design, both classifiers operate outside the generation pipeline and do not use the model’s own representations. This separation can limit prompt-screening accuracy, while the image-side check runs only after the full generation cost has been spent. Moreover, a flagged prompt can only be rejected, even when it could be adjusted to produce a safe image. In this work, we propose the Inner Guardrail (InGuard) , a safety framework that works inside the pipeline on the model’s own representations, leaving base-model parameters untouched. First, a risk classifier grades each prompt as unsafe, risky, or benign based on the text encoder’s embeddings, with no external language model. Second, SAGE (Soft-gated Asymmetric Guardrail for Embeddings) modifies the embeddings of risky prompts, aiming to return a safe image instead of a refusal. Third, a latent detector checks the one-step clean latent estimate midway through denoising, reaching nearly image-level performance and halting generation when risk is detected. We also construct the RevGen Safety Benchmark to evaluate T2I safety under realistic conditions: 10,000 prompts built through real-image reverse generation, with a rewriting step that supplies controlled intellectual-property (IP) characters, covering graded porn/gore risks, categorical IP risks, and benign negatives. Across five open-weight T2I models, InGuard reaches a 97.9–98.8% safety rate on our RevGen benchmark, matching or exceeding the outer guardrail. It reduces benign disturbance by 57.5–73.5% with approximately 3.7 × \times fewer added parameters, and avoids 50–55.6% of denoising steps on requests intercepted mid-generation.

blocks.en: Modern open-weight text-to-image (T2I) models, including Qwen-Image [ Wu et al., 2025 ] , HunyuanImage [ Tencent Hunyuan Team, 2025 ] , FLUX [ Black Forest Labs, 2026 ] , and Z-Image [ Z-Image Team et al., 2025 ] , can generate high-fidelity images from a wide range of natural-language prompts. However, their broad generative capabilities also increase the risk of misuse. Relevant risks include not-safe-for-work (NSFW) content, such as pornographic and gory imagery, and the generation of controlled intellectual-property (IP) characters that may conflict with deployment policies. Deploying these models in public-facing applications therefore requires robust safety mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 现代的开放量产文本对映(T2I)模型,包括Quen-Image [Wu等人,2025年],HunyuanImage [Tencent Hunyuan Team,2025年],FLUX [黑林实验室,2026年],Z-Image [Z-Image Team et al.,2025年],可以从多种自然语言的提示产生高真实度的图像. 然而,它们广泛的遗传能力也增加了滥用的风险。 相关风险包括不安全的工作内容,如色情和血腥图像,以及产生可能与部署政策相冲突的受控制的知识产权字符。 因此,在公开应用中使用这些模型需要强有力的安全机制。

blocks.en: The conventional safety approach forms an outer guardrail around the generation pipeline: a prompt classifier that checks the prompt for risk before generation, and a post-hoc image classifier that checks the fully generated image for NSFW content. This design has three limitations: (1) On the prompt side, the classifier normally relies on an external language model. Real-time deployment pushes it toward compact encoders such as BERT [ Devlin et al., 2019 ] and mE5 [ Wang et al., 2024 ] , whose small representation capacity limits the accuracy of risk assessment. Scaling up to a larger language model can improve accuracy, but it also increases computational overhead. (2) On the image side, the image is checked only after generation is complete. All denoising steps have already finished by the time the check runs, so the compute is wasted whenever a risky image is detected. (3) In the rejection-based configuration, risk detected on either side leads to outright rejection, which degrades the user experience. In practice, many requests can be guided and corrected to generate safe images, rather than rejected as a whole. In-pipeline enhancement methods can achieve this by modifying the prompt or its embeddings [ Schramowski et al., 2023 ; Yoon et al., 2025 ] . All three limitations share the same root: the guardrail is blind to the model’s own representations. It works on the input text and the generated image, not on the embeddings and intermediate features.
blocks.zh: 常规安全方法构成了环绕生成管道的外护栏:即时分级器检查生成前的速率风险,后热图像分级器检查NSFW内容的全部生成图像. 这一设计有三个限制: (1)在即时方面,分类者通常依赖外语模式. 实时部署将其推向紧凑编码器,如BERT[Devlin等人,2019年]和mE5[Wang等人,2024年],其小的表示能力限制了风险评估的准确性. 扩大至更大的语言模型可以提高准确性,但也增加了计算间接费用。 (2)在图像方面,只有在生成完成后才检查图像. 到检查运行时,所有调试步骤都已完成,因此每当检测到有风险的图像,计算就会被浪费. (3)在基于拒绝的配置中,发现任何一方的风险都会导致彻底拒绝,从而降低用户体验. 在实践中,可以引导和纠正许多请求生成安全图像,而不是整体拒绝. 内管增强方法可以通过修改快件或其嵌入物来实现[Schramowski等人,2023年;Yoon等人,2025年]. 所有三个限制都具有相同的根源:护栏对模型本身的表示视而不见。 它致力于输入文本和生成的图像,而不是嵌入和中间特征.

blocks.en: An ideal guardrail for safe T2I generation must be non-invasive, architecturally agnostic, and low-overhead. Therefore, we propose the Inner Guardrail (InGuard) , which meets these requirements by embedding safety plugins at the text-encoding and iterative generation stages. As shown in Figure 1 , unlike the conventional outer guardrail that fully generates an image before checking and discarding it, InGuard embeds these plugins within the pipeline so that the same risky request can still yield a safe image. First, a prompt embedding risk classifier grades each prompt into unsafe, risky, or benign directly on the T2I model’s own text encoder embeddings, inheriting the representation capacity of the large encoder at no additional encoding cost. The graded risk levels then enable differentiated responses: unsafe prompts are intercepted before generation, risky ones are routed to enhancement, and benign ones pass through untouched. Second, we introduce SAGE (Soft-gated Asymmetric Guardrail for Embeddings) to handle risky prompts, aiming to return safe images that preserve the original request instead of outright rejection. SAGE softly blends the embeddings of risky tokens toward a safe subspace, while soft gating aims to limit changes to benign content. Third, during generation, a latent-space safety detector evaluates a one-step estimate of the clean latent at an intermediate generation step to detect residual unsafe content that passes through the first two stages. It attains detection accuracy comparable to image-level filtering while avoiding at least half of the denoising steps for requests intercepted at the selected detection step. Within InGuard, SAGE and the latent-space safety detector give a risky request two possible outcomes, which Figure 2 illustrates on two controlled-IP prompts: the top example shows a successful enhancement that returns a safe image, and the bottom example shows a failed enhancement whose residual risk is caught by the latent-space safety detector.
blocks.zh: 安全T2I一代最理想的护栏 必须是无入侵的 建筑不可知的 低高的 因此,我们提出内部护卫(InGuard),通过在文本编码和迭代生成阶段嵌入安全插件来满足这些要求. 如图1所示,与常规的外护栏不同,在检查和丢弃之前完全生成一个图像,InGuard将这些插件嵌入管道中,这样同样的风险请求仍能产生安全图像. 首先,在T2I模型本身的文本编码器嵌入上,迅速将风险分类器的等级各迅速输入不安全、危险或良性,不增加编码费用地继承大编码器的表示能力。 分级的风险水平就能够作出不同的反应:不安全的提示在生成之前就被截获,危险的提示被引导到增强中,良性提示通过时不受影响。 其次,我们引入了SAGE(Soft-gated Assomical Guardrail for Embeddings)来处理危险的提示,目的是返回安全图像来保存最初的请求而不是彻底拒绝. SAGE将风险符号的嵌入软融合到安全的子空间中,而柔和的Gating旨在限制对良性内容的改变. 第三,在一代人期间,一个潜在空间安全探测器对中间一代人步骤中清洁潜在物的单步估计进行评价,以检测经过前两个阶段的剩余不安全内容。 它的检测精度与图像级别的过滤相当,同时避免了在选定的检测步骤中截获请求时至少一半的除号步骤。 在InGuard内部,SAGE和潜在空间安全探测器给出了两个可能的风险请求,图2说明了两个可控-IP提示:顶端示例显示成功增强,返回安全图像;底端示例显示失败增强,其剩余风险被潜在空间安全探测器抓住.

Top: a successful enhancement returns a safe image. Bottom: a failed enhancement is caught by the latent-space safety detector, and no image is released.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are threefold:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献有三:

blocks.en: • We construct the RevGen Safety Benchmark , a suite of 10,000 prompts reverse-generated from real images for realistic and diverse safety evaluation. It covers three risk dimensions (porn, gore, IP), with fine-grained severity levels for porn/gore, categorical IP labels, and dedicated benign negatives, supporting both risk assessment and false-positive measurement. • We propose InGuard , an in-pipeline safety framework whose graded risk classification routes each prompt to the response that fits: outright interception, safety enhancement for risky prompts, or pass-through with latent-space safety detection. Safety enhancement (SAGE) aims to turn risky requests into safe images that preserve the original intent, achieving a better safety–disturbance tradeoff than outright rejection, and latent-space safety detection attains detection accuracy comparable to image-level filtering while avoiding at least half of the denoising steps for requests intercepted at the selected detection step. The framework is non-invasive and architecturally agnostic, leaving base-model parameters untouched. • We conduct systematic safety evaluation across five open-weight T2I models (Z-Image-Turbo, Qwen-Image-2512, HunyuanImage-2.1, FLUX.2-klein-base-9B, and InternVL-U [ Tian et al., 2026 ] ) on RevGen benchmark. Experiments show that InGuard reaches a 97.9–98.8% safety rate, matching or exceeding the outer guardrail while cutting benign disturbance by 57.5–73.5% with approximately 3.7 × \times fewer added guardrail parameters.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们构建了RevGen安全基准(RevGen Security Basic), 一套10 000个从真实图像中反向生成的电源, 它涵盖三个风险层面(色情、戈尔、IP),对色情/色情物品的严厉程度、明确的IP标签和专用的良性阴性,支持风险评估和假阳性测量。 我们提出InGuard, 一个内管安全框架, 将风险分类路线分级, 逐个对应的反应:直接拦截、加强安全, 增强安全(SAGE)旨在将风险请求转化为安全图像,以保持原意,实现比彻底拒绝更好的安全-混乱权衡,潜在空间安全检测获得与图像一级过滤相当的检测精度,同时避免在选定的检测步骤上至少半次对拦截请求的去名步骤。 该框架是非侵入性的,在建筑上是不可知的,使基本模型参数没有受到影响。 我们在RevGen基准上对5种开放重量的T2I型号(Z-Image-Turbo、Quen-Image-2512、HunyuanImage-2.1、FLUX.2-Klein-base-9B)和InternVL-U[Tian等人,2026])进行系统的安全评价。 实验显示,InGuard的安全率达到97.9-98.8%,在切断良性扰动时比照或超过外部护栏,达到57.5-73.5 %,增加的护栏参数减少。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Research on T2I generation safety has grown in step with the open-weights release of LDMs [ Rombach et al., 2022 ] , Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) [ Peebles and Xie, 2023 ] , and Flow-Matching models [ Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ] . Existing strategies fall into two families: enhancement methods suppress unsafe concepts so that users receive safe images even from risky prompts, whereas detection methods identify risk in prompts or generated content. We review both, together with the safety benchmarks used to evaluate them.
blocks.zh: T2I生成安全研究随着LDMs[Rombach等人,2022年],Difmation Transformers(DiTs)[Peebles and Xie,2023年],Flow-Matching模型[Lipman等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年]的开放量产发布而同步发展. 现有战略分为两个家族:强化方法压制不安全的概念,使用户能够从危险的提示中获取安全图像,而检测方法则在提示中识别风险或生成内容。 我们既审查两者,也审查用于评价它们的安全基准。

blocks.en: 2.1 T2I Safety Enhancement
blocks.zh: 2.1 T2I 加强安全

blocks.en: T2I safety enhancement methods can be classified into training-time and inference-time approaches.
blocks.zh: T2I安全增强方法可分为培训时间和推断时间方法.

blocks.en: Training-time approaches modify model parameters directly, requiring additional training or fine-tuning. Concept Ablation [ Kumari et al., 2023 ] fine-tunes model parameters to align a target concept’s conditional distribution with that of an anchor concept, SafeGen [ Li et al., 2024 ] modifies the self-attention within the U-Net [ Ronneberger et al., 2015 ] to suppress sexually explicit content, and Erased Stable Diffusion [ Gandikota et al., 2023 ] suppresses unsafe concepts through model fine-tuning. Such approaches introduce model-update costs and can affect semantically related benign concepts [ Kumari et al., 2023 ; Gandikota et al., 2023 ] .
blocks.zh: 培训时间办法直接修改模型参数,需要额外的培训或微调. 概念Ablation[Kumari等人,2023年]微调模型参数,使目标概念的有条件分布与锚定概念一致,SafeGen[Li等人,2024年]修改了U-Net[Ronneberger等人,2015年]内部的自我关注,以抑制性明确的内容,Erased Stable Difusion[Gandikota等人,2023年]通过模型微调压制不安全的概念. 这种方法引入了模型更新成本,并可能影响与模型相关的良性概念[Kumari等人,2023年;Gandikota等人,2023年]。

blocks.en: Inference-time methods operate at the text-embedding, latent, or attention level. At the text-embedding level, SAFREE [ Yoon et al., 2025 ] projects trigger tokens away from toxic concept subspaces using a hard trigger threshold. This projection component requires no training and is computed before denoising. SAFREE additionally provides Self-Validating Filtering (SVF), which adjusts conditioning across denoising steps. STG [ Na et al., 2025 ] , Responsible Diffusion [ Li et al., 2025b ] , and ItD [ Tian et al., 2025 ] refine embeddings through per-step gradient ascent or external safe directions, incurring overhead or relying on precomputed components. At the latent level or the attention level, SLD [ Schramowski et al., 2023 ] guides latents away from unsafe regions via classifier-free guidance [ Ho and Salimans, 2021 ] but risks disturbing benign outputs. SafeRoPE [ Yang et al., 2026b ] perturbs positional embeddings in safety-critical attention heads, while CASG [ Xiang et al., 2026 ] dynamically selects category-aligned guidance to address multi-category conflicts and can be applied to latent-space or text-space safeguards.
blocks.zh: 推论时间方法在文本嵌入、潜伏或注意力层面运作。 在文本嵌入水平上,SAFREE [Yoon等人,2025年]项目利用硬触发阈值触发标志,远离有毒概念子空间. 这一预测部分不需要培训,在取消提名之前进行计算。 SAFREE还额外提供自变量过滤器(SVF),可调整跨去诺化步骤的调节. STG [Na 等人,2025],负责任的扩散[Li 等人,2025b],以及 ItD [Tian 等人,2025]通过每步梯度上升或外部安全方向精炼嵌入,引起间接费用或依赖预计算组件. 在潜在水平或关注水平上,SLD[Schramowski等人,2023年]通过无分类指导向远离不安全地区的潜伏者提供指导[Ho和Salimans,2021年],但有可能扰乱良性产出。 SafeRoPE [Yang等人, 2026b] 扰动位置嵌入在安全关键注意力头,而CASG [Xiang等人, 2026] 动态选择类别组合指导以解决多类冲突,并可用于潜在空间或文本空间保障.

blocks.en: 2.2 T2I Safety Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 T2I 安全检测

blocks.en:
Safety detection at the prompt and image sides constitutes a common outer guardrail. On the prompt side, classifiers are often built on compact text encoders such as BERT [ Devlin et al., 2019 ] and mE5 [ Wang et al., 2024 ] , which are separate from the generator’s own text encoder. On the image side, widely deployed classifiers inspect the generated image once the full denoising process finishes. Examples include the built-in safety checker of Stable Diffusion [ Rombach et al., 2022 ] (a CLIP-based filter that flags sexual content), as well as Q16 [ Schramowski et al., 2022 ] , NudeNet [ Bedapudi, 2022 ] , and the LAION classifier [ Schuhmann et al., 2022 ] . Q16 employs prompt-tuning on socio-moral value datasets to classify inappropriate image content. NudeNet provides models for nudity classification and body-part detection and is widely adopted in open-source moderation pipelines. The LAION classifier is a lightweight CLIP-based model that provides NSFW scores for filtering web-scale training corpora such as LAION-5B. Their target labels differ, so coverage of gore or controlled IP characters requires task-specific evaluation or adaptation. Post-hoc detectors also run only after generation completes, and adaptation may be needed when transferring from natural to generated images.
In-generation detection has also been explored. FlowGuard [ Yang et al., 2026a ] uses linear latent decoding and curriculum learning to inspect intermediate denoising states and terminate unsafe generations early.
blocks.zh:
即时和图像两侧的安全探测是共同的外护栏。 在即时方面,分类器经常建立在紧凑的文本编码器上,如BERT[Devlin等人,2019]和mE5[Wang等人,2024],它们与生成器自己的文本编码器分开. 在图像方面,广泛部署的分类器在完全解密过程完成后检查生成的图像. 例子包括稳定扩散的内置安全检查器[Rombach等人,2022年](一个标注性内容的基于CLIP的过滤器),以及Q16[Schramowski等人,2022年],NudeNet [Bedapudi,2022年],LAION分类器[Shuhmann等人,2022年]. Q16使用社会道德价值数据集进行即时调整,对不适当的图像内容进行分类. NudeNet为裸体分类和体段检测提供了模型,并在开源节制管中被广泛采用. LAION分类器是一种基于轻量级CLIP的模型,提供NSFW分数,用于过滤LAION-5B等网络规模训练公司. 其目标标签不同,因此覆盖戈尔或受控IP字符需要针对特定任务的评价或修改. 后热探测器也只在一代完成后运行,在从自然图像转移到生成图像时可能需要进行改造.
还探索了代际探测. FlowGuard[Yang等人,2026a]使用线性潜在解码和课程学习来检查中间去诺状态,提前终止不安全的几代人.

blocks.en: 2.3 T2I Safety Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.3 T2I 安全基准

blocks.en: Existing T2I safety benchmarks, such as I2P [ Schramowski et al., 2023 ] , Ring-A-Bell [ Tsai et al., 2024 ] , MMA-Diffusion [ Yang et al., 2024 ] , T2ISafety [ Li et al., 2025a ] , and Six-CD [ Ren et al., 2025 ] , compile prompts from in-the-wild queries, adversarial transformations, or curated taxonomies. They span multiple risk categories including sexual content, violence, hate, and privacy. Some use fixed prompt sets for static risk profiling, while others apply adversarial attacks or structured concept taxonomies to probe robustness and assess mitigation.
blocks.zh: 现有的T2I安全基准,如I2P[Schramowski等人,2023年],Ring-A-Bell[Tsai等人,2024年],MMA-Difuncation[Yang等人,2024年],T2ISafety[Li等人,2025年a],以及Six-CD[Ren等人,2025年],汇编了来自无端询问,对抗性转化,或曲解分类的提示. 它们涉及多种风险类别,包括性内容、暴力、仇恨和隐私。 有些人使用固定的即时集进行静态风险剖面分析,而另一些人则采用对抗攻击或结构化的概念分类法来探测稳健性并评估缓解措施。

blocks.en: These benchmarks are designed to measure how much risk a model produces. Their annotations therefore record which risks a prompt carries and how often it elicits them, rather than how severe each risk is. Most release risky prompts only. Six-CD also releases benign prompts in two forms: a risky prompt with the unwanted concept deleted, and plain captions from a general web corpus. Neither form explicitly targets the graded near-boundary cases considered here. T2ISafety includes neutral prompts, which target demographic bias. Prompt sets further differ in how reliably they elicit risk, and Six-CD keeps a prompt only if it yields unsafe images in at least four of five generations.
blocks.zh: 这些基准旨在衡量一个模型产生多大风险。 因此,其说明记录了哪些风险是迅速的,引起风险的频率是多少,而不是每一风险的严重程度。 大部分的释放只有危险提示。 Six-CD还以两种形式发布了良性提示:一个是删除了不想要的概念的冒险提示,另一个是一般网络目录的简单标题。 两份表格都没有明确针对本文所考虑的分级的近边界案件。 T2ISafety包括了中性提示,以人口偏差为目标. 快速装置在如何可靠地引起风险方面有进一步的差异,6-CD只在至少五代人中的四代产生不安全图像时才会保持快速.

blocks.en: 3 RevGen Safety Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 订正安全基准

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: The RevGen Safety Benchmark covers three risk dimensions (porn, gore, and IP) together with benign prompts. Prompts carry graded porn/gore labels and categorical IP labels, allowing category- and level-dependent responses rather than a single accept-or-reject decision. The benign prompts include cases written close to a risk category, where false positives are most likely to occur.
blocks.zh: 《订正安全基准》包括三个风险层面(色情、戈尔和知识产权)以及良性提示。 提示带有分级的色情/gore标签和绝对的IP标签,允许依赖类别和级别的回应,而不是一个单一的接受或拒绝的决定. 良性诱因包括写成的接近风险类别的案例,在这些案例中,假阳性最有可能发生.

blocks.en: The prompts are reverse-generated from real images rather than written from a language model’s priors. As Figure 3 shows, an LLM-only pipeline writes prompts from structured configurations, while our pipeline instead passes real source images through a VLM to derive the prompts. Table 1 compares RevGen with existing benchmarks. Among them, RevGen uniquely combines real-image grounding, graded risk labels, and near-boundary benign negatives. Diversity in that table is a qualitative characterization of prompt sources, not a measured score.
blocks.zh: 这些提示来自真实的图像而不是语言模型的前身。 如图3所示,仅LLM的管道会从结构化配置中写入提示,而我们的管道则会通过VLM通过真实的源图像来获取提示. 表1比较了RevGen与现有基准。 其中RevGen独具特色地结合了真象地面,分级风险标签,以及近界良性底片. 该表的多样性是对迅速来源的定性,而不是衡量得分。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Schematic comparison of prompt-generation approaches. (a) An LLM-only pipeline uses structured configurations. (b) Our reverse-generation pipeline derives prompts from real images.
blocks.zh: 图3:快速生成方法的示意图比较。 (a) 仅使用LLM的管道采用结构化配置。 (b) 我们的逆向生成管道来自真实的图像。

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison with existing T2I safety benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表1:与现有的T2I安全基准的比较。

blocks.en: 3.2 VLM-Driven Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 VLM-驱动生成管道

blocks.en: The VLM-driven reverse generation pipeline consists of four stages: source image pooling, VLM-driven reverse generation, IP character rewriting for a subset of prompts, and clustering-based diversity sampling. Each stage is described below. The resulting prompts are then rendered by the T2I models, which supports the measurements reported in Sections 3.3 and 3.4 .
blocks.zh: VLM驱动的反向生成管道由四个阶段组成:源图像集合,VLM驱动的反向生成,IP字符重写一个子集的提示,以及基于集群的多样性采样. 下文介绍每个阶段。 由此产生的提示由T2I模型提供,支持第3.3和3.4节所报告的测量。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Stage 1: Source Image Pooling
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 阶段1:源图像集合

blocks.en: The VLM reverse generation path draws from a pre-shuffled pool of source images collected from the internet. The pool is assembled to cover all target risk categories.
blocks.zh: VLM反向生成路径来自从互联网上收集的预流源图像集合. 集合后将涵盖所有目标风险类别。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Stage 2: VLM-Driven Reverse Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 阶段2:VLM-驱动反向生成

blocks.en: The core of our pipeline is a reverse generation process that bridges real-world imagery and text-to-image prompt design. Our method begins with real source images and leverages a VLM to convert each image into a text-to-image prompt intended to reproduce its main visual elements when fed to an LDM. This reverse generation strategy grounds the resulting prompts in the visual complexity, composition, and context of real images.
blocks.zh: 我们管道的核心是一个反向生成过程,它连接现实世界的图像和文本到图像的即时设计。 我们的方法从真实的源图像开始,并且利用一个VLM将每个图像转换成文本到图像的提示,意图在输入到一个LDM时复制其主要的视觉元素. 这种反向生成策略将由此产生的诱因作为真实图像的视觉复杂性、组成和背景的依据。

blocks.en: For each source image, a VLM generates descriptive text-to-image prompts in both English and Chinese, which increases linguistic diversity. The VLM is instructed to capture key visual elements, including objects, scenes, actions, styles, and spatial relationships, so that the resulting prompts faithfully represent the original image content. Figure 4 (top) compares real source images with the images regenerated from the VLM-derived prompts, illustrating how the generated prompts retain scene elements from the source images in these selected examples. This VLM reverse generation process produces the benchmark’s pornographic and gore prompts and the initial benign prompts, some of which are subsequently rewritten into controlled or benign IP variants.
blocks.zh: 对于每个源图像,一个VLM都会生成英语和汉语的描述性文字对图像的提示,这增加了语言多样性. VLM被指示捕捉关键视觉元素,包括物体,场景,动作,风格,和空间关系,这样产生的提示忠实地代表了原始的图像内容. 图4(top)将真实的源图像与从VLM生成的提示中重新生成的图像进行比较,说明生成的提示如何保留这些选定示例中源图像的场景元素. 这种VLM反向生成过程产生基准的色情和gore提示和最初的良性提示,其中一些随后被改写为受控或良性IP变体.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Top: VLM-driven reverse generation: source images (left) and Z-Image-Turbo regenerations from the VLM-derived prompts (right). Only benign examples are shown for visual safety. Source images are blurred to protect the privacy of the individuals they may contain. Bottom: IP character rewriting: source images (left) and Z-Image-Turbo regenerations from IP-rewritten prompts (right), covering both controlled and benign non-controlled IP characters.
blocks.zh: 图4:顶部:VLM驱动的反向生成:源图像(左)和Z-Image-Turbo再生从VLM衍生的提示(右). 为了视觉安全,只显示良性的例子。 源图像模糊,以保护其可能包含的个人的隐私. 底部:IP字符重写:源图像(左)和Z-Image-Turbo再生从IP重写提示(右),既涵盖受控字符,也涵盖良性非受控IP字符.

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Stage 3: IP Character Rewriting
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 阶段3: IP字符重写

blocks.en: Source images of copyrighted characters are scarce in the image pool, so direct VLM reverse generation cannot produce enough diverse IP prompts. To address this, IP-related prompts are generated through a specialized rewriting step. From a pool of VLM-generated normal prompts, an LLM systematically injects IP entities to produce four sub-categories. The first category comprises controlled IP prompts, which directly mention one of five controlled IP characters (Snow White, Doraemon, Minions, Elsa, and SpongeBob SquarePants), covering both single-character and multi-character scenarios. The remaining three categories are benign IP variants that should not be flagged: non-controlled copyrighted characters (e.g., Luffy, Conan), associated characters from the same franchise (e.g., Nobita for Doraemon, Patrick Star for SpongeBob), and lookalike characters that share visual features with a controlled IP but are not the original entity (e.g., “a round blue robot animal without ears” as a Doraemon lookalike). This last category tests whether the system distinguishes a controlled character’s identity from visual similarity under the benchmark policy. Figure 4 (bottom) illustrates the IP rewriting process, showing source images alongside their IP-rewritten counterparts. Recall is measured only on the five controlled characters, while the benign sub-categories test false positives under this policy.
blocks.zh: 在图像池中版权人物的原始图像很少,因此直接的VLM反向生成无法产生足够多样的IP提示. 为了解决这个问题,通过专门的重写步骤产生了与IP有关的提示. 从一组VLM生成的普通提示中,LLM系统注入IP实体生成4个子类. 第一类包括受控IP提示,直接提到5个受控IP字符中的一个(雪白,哆啦A梦,Minions,Elsa,和海绵宝宝SquarePants),涵盖单字符和多字符两种情景. 其余三个类别是良性的IP变体,不应标注:非控制版权的字符(如路飞,柯南),来自同一特许权的关联字符(如哆啦A梦的Nobita,Patrick Star的SpongeBob),以及拥有受控IP但并非原实体(如"圆形蓝色机器人动物无耳"为哆啦A梦外观的外观字符). 最后一类测试系统是否根据基准政策将一个受控字符的身份与视觉相似性区分开来. 图4(下方)显示IP重写过程,显示源图像与IP重写对应方. 仅根据5个受控字符来计量召回,而良性亚类则根据这一政策测试假阳性.

blocks.en: 3.2.4 Stage 4: Clustering-Based Diversity Sampling
blocks.zh: 3.2.4 国家 第4阶段:基于集群的多样性抽样

blocks.en: Prompts within each sub-category are embedded with TF-IDF [ Spärck Jones, 1972 ] followed by truncated SVD, then grouped with K-Means [ Lloyd, 1982 ] . From each cluster we take the prompts closest to the centroid, up to a fixed per-cluster cap. The cap limits the contribution of any single cluster without requiring equal counts from clusters of different sizes. The trainset and testset are generated independently with source-image-level separation: prompts derived from the same source image, including English/Chinese versions and IP rewrites, remain in the same split. MinHash-LSH [ Broder, 1997 ] deduplication is additionally applied between the splits to reduce textual overlap.
blocks.zh: 每个子类内的提示被嵌入到TF-IDF [Spärck Jones,1972] 之后是短音SVD,然后与K-Means [Lloyd,1982]分组. 从每个星团中,我们采取最接近百分数的提示, 最高达到每个星团固定的上限。 上限限制任何单个集群的贡献,而不要求大小不同的集群进行等量计算. 列车集和测试集是用源图像级别分离独立生成的:来自同一源图像的提示,包括英文/中文版本和IP重写,仍保留在同一拆分中. MinHash-LSH [Broder, 1997] 拆分法在拆分法之间额外应用,以减少文字重叠.

blocks.en: 3.3 Generated-Image Diversity
blocks.zh: 3.3 生成-图像多样性

blocks.en: We measure generated-image diversity with the Vendi Score [ Friedman and Dieng, 2022 ] , using a cosine similarity matrix of L2-normalized CLS features from a frozen DINOv2 ViT-B/14 encoder [ Oquab et al., 2023 ] . Table 2 reports the Vendi Score of each benchmark across five LDMs. The Vendi Score corresponds to the effective number of distinct modes in a generated set, so higher values indicate a wider spread of visual content. RevGen attains the highest diversity on three of the five models, reaching 79.72 on FLUX.2-klein-base-9B, 58.80 on Qwen-Image-2512, and 52.97 on InternVL-U. T2ISafety is the strongest existing benchmark and leads on the other two models, Z-Image-Turbo and HunyuanImage-2.1. The pattern is broadly consistent with the prompt-source design summarized in Table 1 : reverse generation from a varied pool of real images spans a broad range of scenes, and this variety carries over to the generated images.
blocks.zh: 我们用Vendi Score [Friedman and Dieng, 2022] 测量生成的图像多样性,使用冷冻的DINov2 ViT-B/14编码器[Oquab等人, 2023年]的L2常态CLS特征的余弦相似性矩阵。 表2按五个LDM报告每个基准的Vendi分数。 Vendi 分数对应生成集中不同模式的有效数量,因此较高的值表明视觉内容的传播范围更广. RevGen在五种模式中三种获得最高多样性,在FLUX.2-Klein-base-9B上达到79.72,在Quen-Image-2512上达到58.80,在InternVL-U上达到52.97. T2ISafety是现存最强的基准,领先于其他两种模式Z-Image-Turbo和HunyuanImage-2.1. 该模式与表1概述的即时源设计基本一致:从各种真实图像库中逆向生成的图像跨越了广泛的场景,这种多样性延续到生成的图像.

blocks.en: Table 2: Generated-image diversity measured by the DINOv2-Vendi Score.
blocks.zh: 表2:由DINOv2-Vendi分数测量的生成-图像多样性.

blocks.en: 3.4 Risk Elicitation Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.4 风险信息统计

blocks.en: To verify that the prompts elicit risk, we generate an image for every prompt with each of the five LDMs and measure the Risk Hit Ratio, the proportion of generated images flagged as risky by the Qwen3.7-Plus image-level annotator [ Yang et al., 2025 ] . Risky prompts reach 21.60%–94.00% across dimensions and models, while no benign sub-category exceeds 3.20%.
blocks.zh: 为了证实提示引起风险,我们用5个LDM中的每个提示生成一个图像,并测量风险命中率,即由Qune3.7-Plus图像级别注释员标出的风险生成图像的比例[Yang等人,2025年]。 跨维度和模型的风险率达到21.60~94.00%,而无良性亚类超过3.20%.

blocks.en: The hit ratio also supports a cross-benchmark comparison on the pornographic category. As shown in Table 3 , RevGen produces the highest hit ratio on four of the five models. The exception is FLUX.2-klein-base-9B, where Ring-A-Bell reaches 52.78% against 30.50% for RevGen. Ring-A-Bell and Six-CD are the strongest existing benchmarks, and both raise their ratios by construction: Ring-A-Bell optimizes prompts adversarially against earlier Stable Diffusion checkpoints, so its ratios here reflect how well those attacks transfer, while Six-CD retains only prompts that already yield unsafe images. The remaining benchmarks stay below 26% on all five models, including MMA-Diffusion, whose adversarial prompts were likewise tuned against earlier checkpoints. Overall, RevGen can elicit risk from current models without adversarial optimization or model-specific filtering, relying only on prompts derived from real images.
blocks.zh: 点击率也支持对色情类进行跨基准比较. 如表3所示,RevGen在五个型号中的四个型号上产生最高的命中率. FLUX.2-Klein-base-9B是例外,Ring-A-Bell达到52.78%,而RevGen为30.50%. Ring-A-Bell和Six-CD是现有最强的基准,两者都通过建筑提高比率: Ring-A-Bell优化了对先前的稳定扩散检查站的对抗性,因此其比例反映了这些攻击转移情况,而Six-CD只保留已经产生不安全图像的提示。 其余基准在所有5种模式中都低于26%,包括MMA-Difusion,其对抗性诱因也与以前的检查站相对应。 总体而言,RevGen可以在不进行对抗优化或针对模型的过滤的情况下,从当前模型中引出风险,只能依靠真实图像产生的提示.

blocks.en: Table 3: Risk elicitation on pornographic prompts.
blocks.zh: 表3:淫秽诱发的风险。

blocks.en: 4 InGuard Framework
blocks.zh: 4 安保框架

blocks.en: 4.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en: In this section, we present our InGuard framework, consisting of three complementary components that operate at different stages of the generation pipeline, as shown in Figure 5 . First, prompt embedding risk classification assesses the text encoder’s output embeddings to assign multi-dimensional risk labels before generation begins. Based on the graded severity, each prompt takes one of three paths: unsafe prompts are intercepted outright; benign prompts enter generation unmodified; the remaining risky prompts are routed to the second component, SAGE (Soft-gated Asymmetric Guardrail for Embeddings), which performs embedding-space safety enhancement. The third component, latent-space safety detection, operates during the diffusion process: it monitors intermediate latents via a safety classifier and can abort generation early if risk is detected. PE-MLP screens every input prompt, SAGE modifies only the risky branch, and the latent detector checks every request that reaches generation at a selected denoising step. This secondary check can catch residual risks missed by prompt-level screening or enhancement.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了我们的InGuard框架,框架由三个互补部分组成,在发电管道的不同阶段运作,如图5所示。 首先,即时嵌入风险分类评估文本编码器的输出嵌入,以便在生成开始前指定多维风险标签. 根据分级的严重程度,每个提示都走三条路径中的一条: 不安全的提示被直接拦截; 良性提示进入生成时未修改; 剩下的危险提示被路由到第二个组件SAGE(Soft-gated As不对称的嵌入式护栏),它进行嵌入式空间安全增强. 第三个组成部分,即潜在空间安全探测,在扩散过程中运作:它通过安全分类器监测中间潜伏物,如果发现风险,可以提前中止生成。 PE-MLP屏幕显示每个输入提示,SAGE只修改风险分支,潜伏的探测器检查每一个在选定的去诺步骤到达生成的请求. 这种二级检查可捕捉及时筛选或增强而错过的剩余风险。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Overview of our InGuard framework. Three complementary components work in sequence: (1) prompt embedding risk classification assigns multi-dimensional risk labels and intercepts unsafe prompts, (2) SAGE performs embedding-space safety enhancement, and (3) latent-space safety detection monitors intermediate latents during denoising.
blocks.zh: 图5:我们InGuard框架概览。 三个互补组件按顺序工作:(1) 快速嵌入风险分类指定了多维风险标签并拦截了不安全的提示;(2) SAGE执行嵌入空间安全增强;(3) 潜在空间安全检测监测器在解密过程中的中间潜伏.

blocks.en: 4.2 Prompt Embedding Risk Classification
blocks.zh: 4.2 快速嵌入风险分类

blocks.en: Before applying safety enhancement, each prompt is classified into multi-dimensional risk categories at the embedding level. The classifier operates directly on the text encoder’s output embeddings, which are the same embeddings that subsequently condition the diffusion process, requiring no additional text encoding pass. Risk is assessed along three independent dimensions: pornographic, gore, and IP-controlled content.
blocks.zh: 在应用安全增强之前,每个提示在嵌入级被分为多维风险类别. 分类器直接运行在文本编码器的输出嵌入上,这些嵌入与随后对扩散过程构成条件的嵌入相同,不需要额外的文本编码通过. 风险按三个独立方面来评估:色情、戈尔和IP控制的内容。

blocks.en: The text encoder produces a variable-length sequence of token embeddings. Some models provide an attention mask for valid tokens, for which we use masked mean pooling. When no mask is available, plain mean pooling is applied instead, yielding a fixed-length representation: 𝐞 ¯ = ∑ i = 1 L m i ​ 𝐞 i ∑ i = 1 L m i , \bar{\mathbf{e}}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{L}m_{i}\,\mathbf{e}_{i}}{\sum_{i=1}^{L}m_{i}}, (1) where m i ∈ { 0 , 1 } m_{i}\in\{0,1\} is the mask for token i i (set to 1 when no mask is provided). The pooled vector is then classified by a multi-task MLP with a shared backbone and three independent heads. The classifier is trained using multi-task cross-entropy on prompt embeddings from the RevGen Safety Benchmark.

blocks.en: SAGE suppresses toxic concepts in the prompt embedding space by identifying trigger tokens and projecting them away from a toxic concept subspace, with per-token projection intensity controlled continuously and asymmetrically. It operates directly on the text encoder’s output embeddings, requiring no model modification or additional training. Given risk labels, SAGE modifies the output embeddings through four components: (1) label-gated concept selection defines the toxic subspace based on risk categories, (2) leave-one-out analysis yields per-token toxicity ratios, (3) asymmetric soft-gated blending merges original and projected embeddings, and (4) category-aware α \alpha configuration parameterizes the blending threshold. blocks.en: Only user content tokens (the actual prompt words, as opposed to structural tokens such as chat template markers, system prompts, and padding) are candidates for trigger detection and projection, while structural tokens are preserved unchanged throughout. Instead of using all 34 concepts for every prompt, we dynamically select the concept subset based on the risk labels from Section 4.2 . Once a prompt is flagged, each active risk dimension activates its corresponding concept group. A non-zero porn level selects all 13 pornographic concepts. A non-zero gore level selects all 11 gore concepts. An IP level in [ 1 , 5 ] [1,5] selects only that character’s concept vectors. Unlike porn and gore, where all sub-concepts within the category may be relevant, each IP character defines an independent concept subspace, so projecting unrelated characters would introduce unnecessary disturbance. Multiple risk dimensions are handled by merging the corresponding concept groups. Prompts below the enhancement threshold on every dimension skip SAGE and therefore incur no enhancement-induced disturbance, although latent detection can still intercept them. Label-gating is intended to avoid modification along unrelated concept directions; its effectiveness depends on the predicted labels and the coverage of the concept set. The single-label IP head selects one controlled character per prompt, so it does not explicitly represent all controlled characters in a multi-character scene.

blocks.en: 4.4 Latent-Space Safety Detection
blocks.zh: 4.4 低空安全探测

blocks.en: While the embedding-space enhancement suppresses unsafe content at the text level before generation begins, it cannot guarantee complete elimination, since some risky content may survive in subtle or implicit forms. We therefore introduce a latent-space detection track that runs alongside the diffusion process. Modern latent diffusion models generate images through an iterative denoising process in the latent space of a variational autoencoder (VAE) [ Kingma and Welling, 2014 ] . The intermediate latents allow early termination: once a latent exhibits risk indicators, generation is aborted and all subsequent denoising steps are skipped. However, latent representations differ fundamentally from natural RGB images in channel count, spatial resolution, and distribution, so ImageNet-pretrained backbones require input adaptation. We use domain-adaptive pretraining to improve their initialization for latent classification. In the following, we first describe how detection latents are obtained from the flow-matching generation process, then present the latent detector backbone and the two-stage training strategy.
blocks.zh: 虽然嵌入空间增强在生成开始前抑制了文本层面的不安全内容,但它不能保证完全消除,因为一些风险内容可能以微妙或隐含的形式存在. 因此,我们采用了一种潜在的空间探测轨道,该轨道与扩散过程同时运行。 现代潜在传播模型通过变异自编码器(VAE)潜在空间的迭代解码过程生成图像[Kingma and Welling, 2014]. 中间潜伏物允许提前终止:一旦出现潜在风险指标,即中止生成,并跳过所有随后的去名步骤。 然而,潜在的表达方式在通道计数,空间分辨率和分布方面与自然的RGB图像有着根本的不同,因此ImageNet预设的主干线需要投入的调整. 我们使用域适应性预训来改进它们的初始化,以进行潜在的分类. 在下文中,我们首先描述如何从流量匹配生成过程中获得探测潜力,然后介绍潜在的探测器主干线和两阶段培训战略。

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Latent Detector Backbone
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 后期探测器后骨

blocks.en: The detector backbone is ConvNeXt-Base [ Liu et al., 2022 ] (88.6M), initialized from ImageNet-1K [ Deng et al., 2009 ] pretrained weights. Standard image classifiers expect 3-channel RGB inputs, but VAE-encoded latents have C C channels (where C C depends on the target VAE), so we modify the patchify stem, the first Conv2d layer, to accept C C -channel inputs while keeping its kernel size, stride, and output dimensions unchanged. The rest of the backbone retains its ImageNet pretrained weights, preserving the pretrained feature hierarchy while enabling the network to operate directly on latent representations. Input resolution is set to the backbone’s native resolution ( 224 × 224 224\times 224 ). Three classification heads share the backbone for multi-task safety detection: the porn and gore heads are binary classifiers, and the IP head is a multi-class classifier with output dimension K + 1 K{+}1 (covering K = 5 K{=}5 controlled IPs plus one “other” category). Any IP label outside [ 1 , 5 ] [1,5] is mapped to “other” during training. All heads are two-layer MLPs on the backbone’s global-average-pooled features, trained with CrossEntropyLoss.

blocks.en: Latent representations differ from the natural RGB images used for ImageNet pretraining: they are spatially compressed, use VAE-specific channels, and encode features rather than pixel values. Replacing the RGB stem enables the backbone to accept these inputs, but direct safety fine-tuning must learn the domain adaptation from safety-labeled data alone. Phase A first trains the backbone to extract image-semantic features from latents through feature distillation, providing an initialization for subsequent safety classification. Its benefit is measured against the no-distillation baseline in Section 5.4 .

blocks.en: 4.4.4 Training Phase B: Safety Fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 4.4.4 培训阶段B:安全调整

blocks.en: The pretrained backbone is fully fine-tuned on safety-labeled latents extracted from the RevGen Safety Benchmark’s generation process. Full fine-tuning is preferred over freezing the backbone and training only the heads, because Phase A provides domain-adaptive features but not safety-specific ones, and the backbone must further specialize to distinguish safety-relevant content. The three heads are trained jointly with cross-entropy loss, sharing a common backbone representation while maintaining head-specific decision boundaries, the same multi-task principle used in the prompt risk classifier.
blocks.zh: 从RevGen安全基准生成过程中提取的安全标签潜伏物上,经过预先培训的骨干已作了充分的微调。 完全微调优于冻结骨干,只培训头部,因为A阶段提供域调整功能,但并非安全特定功能,骨干必须进一步专门区分与安全相关的内容. 三位头部与交叉内损共同训练,共享一个共同的骨干代表,同时保持头部特定决定界限,这也是在即时风险分类器中使用的多任务原则.

blocks.en: Training data is organized into risk groups: porn, gore, IP-controlled characters, borderline samples (visually ambiguous content at the boundary between safe and unsafe, such as suggestive but non-explicit imagery or mild violence), and normal images. Borderline samples are included to expose the classifier to ambiguous cases near the safety boundary. Stratified sampling balances representation across these categories, preventing the majority class (normal images) from dominating training and ensuring that rare categories receive adequate gradient signal. Training and test data are separated by source image, keeping all derived prompt variants within their split. We additionally filter testset IDs from the training data to exclude direct ID overlap.
blocks.zh: 培训数据分为风险群体:色情、戈尔、IP控制字符、边缘样本(在安全与不安全的边界,如暗示性但非说明性的图像或轻微暴力)和正常图像。 列入边界样本是为了让分类人员在安全边界附近接触模棱两可的情况。 这些类别的抽样平衡分布,防止多数阶层(正常图像)主导培训,确保稀有类别获得适当的梯度信号。 训练和测试数据通过源图像进行分离,将所有衍生的即时变体都保留在其分裂内. 我们还从培训数据中过滤测试集ID,以排除直接ID重叠。

blocks.en: At evaluation time, all three heads use argmax prediction, without additional score-threshold tuning for the detector heads. The porn and gore binary heads are evaluated via F1 score and accuracy, and the IP head is evaluated by treating the K K controlled IP classes as positive and the “other” class as negative, then computing the same binary metrics.
blocks.zh: 在评价时,所有三个头都使用agmax预测,没有为探测器头额外的分数阈值调值. 色情和戈尔二进制头部通过F1分数和准确度来评价,IP头部通过将KK控制下的IP类视为正数和"其他"类视为负数来评价,然后计算相同的二进制度量.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate InGuard through experiments organized to mirror the method’s three-component structure. We first describe the unified experimental setup, then evaluate each component individually: prompt embedding risk classification, SAGE embedding-space enhancement, and latent-space safety detection including computational efficiency. We finally present the system-level comparison of our InGuard and the conventional outer guardrail along two dimensions: the safety rate and the benign disturbance rate.
blocks.zh: 我们通过实验来评价InGuard, 我们首先描述统一的实验设置,然后逐个评价每个组件:即时嵌入风险分类、SAGE嵌入空间增强,以及包括计算效率在内的潜在空间安全检测。 最后,我们从两个方面,即安全率和良性扰动率,对我们的InGuard和常规外护铁路进行了系统层面的比较。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Datasets

Safety-supervised training uses data constructed with the RevGen pipeline, and evaluation uses the 10,000-prompt RevGen testset with labels across porn (0–5), gore (0–5), and IP (0–7). The latent-detector experiments vary the safety-training pool from 5K to 50K.
Phase A domain-adaptive pretraining instead uses VAE-encoded natural images from OpenImages [ Kuznetsova et al., 2020 ] .
blocks.zh:
安全监督培训使用用RevGen管道构建的数据,评价使用10000即时的RevGen测试集,标签横跨色情(0-5),gore(0-5)和IP(0-7). 潜伏探测器实验将安全训练池从5K到50K不等.
A阶段的域适应预训改用OpenImages的VAE编码自然图像[Kuznetsova等人,2020年].

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Baselines and Comparisons
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 基线和比较

blocks.en: We evaluate on five open-weight LDMs: Z-Image-Turbo [ Z-Image Team et al., 2025 ] , Qwen-Image-2512 [ Wu et al., 2025 ] , HunyuanImage-2.1 [ Tencent Hunyuan Team, 2025 ] , FLUX.2-klein-base-9B [ Black Forest Labs, 2026 ] , and InternVL-U [ Tian et al., 2026 ] . All generation, VAE encoding, and evaluation pipelines are implemented with the Diffusers library [ von Platen et al., 2022 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们评价5个开放式LDM: Z-Image-Turbo [Z-Image Team et al., 2025], Quen-Image-2512 [Wu et al., 2025], HunyuanImage-2.1 [Tencent Hunyuan Team, 2025], FLUX.2-Klein-base-9B [黑森林实验室, 2026], InternVL-U [Tian et al., 2026]. 所有世代,VAE编码,评价管道与Diffuses库一起实施[von Platen et al., 2022].

blocks.en: We compare two guardrail paradigms: the conventional outer guardrail and our InGuard. The outer guardrail screens the prompt with a text classifier (mE5-base or mBERT-cased) and the generated image with an image classifier (ConvNeXt-Base). The inner guardrail operates within the LDM pipeline: PE-MLP classifies prompts on the LDM’s text encoder embeddings, SAGE suppresses toxic concept directions in the embeddings, and a latent detector (ConvNeXt-Base on intermediate latents) checks generation at a selected intermediate step. We choose SAFREE [ Yoon et al., 2025 ] as the primary baseline for SAGE, since it can also serve as an embedding-space enhancement component within the inner guardrail.
blocks.zh: 我们比较两个护卫模式:常规的外护卫和我们的护卫。 外护栏用文本分类器(mE5-base或mBERT-cased)屏幕显示提示,用图像分类器(ConvNEXt-Base)显示生成的图像. 在LDM管道内运行的内护铁道:PE-MLP在LDM的文本编码器嵌入物上进行提示,SAGE在嵌入物中抑制有毒概念方向,以及一个潜伏探测器(ConvNeXt-Base on 中间潜伏物)在选定的中间步骤上检查生成. 我们选择SAFREE [Yoon等人,2025年]作为SAGE的主要基线,因为它也可以作为内护栏内嵌入空间增强组件.

blocks.en: 5.2 Prompt Embedding Risk Classification
blocks.zh: 5.2 快速嵌入风险分类

blocks.en: The prompt embedding risk classifier assigns multi-dimensional risk labels directly on LDM text encoder embeddings. The five LDM backends adopt heterogeneous text encoders: Qwen3-4B/8B [ Yang et al., 2025 ] , Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ Bai et al., 2025 ] (paired with ByT5 [ Xue et al., 2022 ] in HunyuanImage-2.1), and InternVL3.5 [ Wang et al., 2025 ] . We compare the inner PE-MLP classifier against outer text classifiers (mE5 and mBERT) in terms of multi-class accuracy and prompt-side false alarm (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 即时嵌入风险分类器直接在LDM文本编码器嵌入上分配多维风险标签. 五个 LDM 后端采用不同的文本编码器: Qune3-4B/8B [Yang等人,2025年], Qune2.5-VL-7B [Bai等人,2025年] (在HunyuanImage-2.1中与ByT5 [Xe等人,2022年]合著), InternVL3.5 [Wang等人,2025年]. 我们比较内PE-MLP分类器与外文本分类器(mE5和mBERT)的多类精确度和即时侧假警报(表5).

blocks.en: PE-MLP consistently outperforms both outer classifiers across all risk dimensions and all five LDMs (Table 5 ), while using over 10 × \times fewer parameters than either outer classifier, leveraging the rich semantic representations already encoded by the LDM’s own text encoder. At operational thresholds, PE-MLP yields a lower prompt-side false alarm than both outer classifiers on every model, indicating fewer false risk flags on benign prompts. These flags determine routing and need not cause direct rejection.
blocks.zh: PE-MLP的性能始终高于所有风险维度的外部分类器和所有五个LDM(表5),同时使用超过10×\时的参数少于外部分类器,利用LDM自己的文本编码器已经编码的丰富的语义表示. 在操作阈值下,PE-MLP在每种模型上产生的即时侧假警报比两个外层分级器都低,表明良性提示上的假风险标记较少. 这些旗帜决定了路线,不需要引起直接拒绝.

blocks.en: Table 5: Multi-class accuracy and prompt-side false alarm (FA) comparison.
blocks.zh: 表5:多级准确度和即时侧假警报比较.

blocks.en: 5.3 Embedding-Space Safety Enhancement
blocks.zh: 5.3 嵌入式空间安全增强

blocks.en:
We compare SAGE with SAFREE [ Yoon et al., 2025 ] . For enhancement success, both methods are evaluated on the same pool of prompts flagged by PE-MLP, using the enhancement thresholds porn ≥ 3 \geq 3 , gore ≥ 2 \geq 2 , or IP ∈ [ 1 , 5 ] \in[1,5] .
Enhancement success rate is the fraction of originally unsafe generations in this shared PE-MLP-flagged pool that are judged safe by the VLM after enhancement. Benign disturbance rate is the fraction of samples in the same pool whose prompt and original image are both safe but whose enhanced generation is judged semantically altered by the VLM. Both methods use identical denominators for each metric. Success measures risk removal, not preservation of the request’s non-risk semantics.
blocks.zh:
我们比较SAGE与SAFREE[Yoon等人,2025年]. 为了增强成功,两种方法都通过PE-MLP标注的相同的提示集合来评价,使用增强阈值的色情作品 3\geq 3, gore 2\geq 2,或者IP Q[1,5]\ in [1,5].
增强成功率是这个共享的PE-MLP旗下集合中原本不安全的几代人的一小部分,在增强后被VLM判定为安全. Benign扰动率是同一池中样本的一小部分,这些样本的迅速和原始图像既安全,但增强的生成量被VLM判断为有变异. 两种方法对每种度量标准使用相同的分母. 成功措施有可能消除,而不是保留请求的非风险语义。

blocks.en: Table 6 presents the results. At the reported operating points, SAGE outperforms SAFREE on all five LDMs, improving success by 8.5–24.9% while reducing benign disturbance by 1.1–5.1%. The largest success gain occurs on InternVL-U, where SAGE nearly doubles the conversion rate (54.1% vs. 29.2%) at less than half the disturbance (1.2% vs. 2.6%). Although absolute success levels vary across LDMs, SAGE achieves a better safety–disturbance tradeoff in each reported comparison.
blocks.zh: 表6列出结果。 在所报告的操作点,SAGE在所有五个LDM上都超过了SAFREE,成功率提高了8.5-24.9%,同时将良性扰动减少了1.1-5.1%。 最大的成功收益发生在InternVL-U, SAGE几乎是转换率的两倍(54.1%对29.2%),不到扰动的一半(1.2%对2.6%)。 虽然各个LDM的绝对成功水平不同,但SAGE在每次报告的比较中都实现了更好的安全-混乱权衡。

blocks.en: Table 6: Comparison between SAGE and SAFREE across five LDMs.
blocks.zh: 表6:五个LDM的SAGE和SAREE的比较.

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows qualitative examples of SAGE’s embedding-space enhancement across five LDMs and three risk categories. For pornographic prompts, the selected examples show added clothing while retaining recognizable subjects and scene elements. For gory prompts, unsafe content is replaced with a benign counterpart, such as a professional medical scene. For controlled-IP prompts, the target character is replaced or removed, while some surrounding objects remain recognizable. These examples illustrate how embedding-space intervention can produce safe alternatives by the proposed SAGE.
blocks.zh: 图9显示SAGE在五个LDM和三个风险类别中嵌入空间增强的定性实例。 对于色情提示,所选示例显示在保留可识别主题和场景元素的同时增加了服装. 对于血栓,不安全的内容被一个良性对应物所取代,比如专业的医疗场景. 对于受控-IP提示,目标字符被替换或移除,而一些周边对象仍然可以识别. 这些例子说明嵌入空间干预如何通过拟议的SAGE产生安全的替代品。

Column groups, left to right: porn, gore, controlled IP. Each pair shows the original generation (left) and the SAGE-enhanced generation (right).
blocks.zh: 图9:部分SAGE增强实例. 行,上下行:Z-Image-Turbo,Qwen-Image-2512,HunyuanImage-2.1,FLUX.2-Klein-base-9B,InternVL-U. 列组,左到右行组:色情, gore,控制IP. 每对显示原代(左)和SAGE增强代(右).

blocks.en: 5.4 Latent-Space Safety Detection
blocks.zh: 5.4 底座-空间安全探测

blocks.en: Latent representations differ from natural RGB images, and adapting ImageNet-pretrained backbones requires replacing the input stem to accept C C -channel latent inputs. Phase A feature distillation adapts the pretrained features to this input domain before safety fine-tuning. We evaluate two aspects of the detector: the accuracy gains from distillation pretraining and the efficiency of detecting at intermediate denoising steps. We further compare pretraining and fine-tuning data generation costs to assess the practicality of large-scale pretraining.
blocks.zh: Latint 表示与自然的RGB图像不同,调整ImageNet预先训练的骨干需要替换输入干,以接受C-通道的潜在输入. 阶段 一个特性蒸馏在安全微调前,将预先训练的特性适应这个输入域. 我们评价探测器的两个方面:蒸馏预试的精度提高和中间去诺步骤的探测效率。 我们进一步比较预训和微调数据生成成本,以评估大规模预训的实用性.

blocks.en: To demonstrate the effect of the proposed distillation pretraining, we compare two latent detector configurations across four training pool sizes (5K–50K) for all five LDMs. The configurations are: (1) Latent (w/o pretrain) : latent input with ImageNet-1K pretraining, no distillation; (2) Latent (w/ distill. pretrain.) : latent input with Phase A distillation pretraining. Performance is measured by Avg F1, which is the mean of the F1 scores across the three risk categories.
blocks.zh: 为了显示拟议的蒸馏预训练的效果,我们比较了所有五个LDM在四个训练池大小(5K-50K)上的两个潜在探测器配置. 构型为:(1)Latent(w/o pretrain) :使用ImageNet-1K预训潜伏输入,不蒸馏;(2)Latent(w/蒸馏. pretrain.) : 潜在输入 A阶段蒸馏预训. 性能由Avg F1来测量,这是F1在三种风险类别中得分的平均值.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 11 , distillation pretraining improves Avg F1 at every tested pool size on all five LDMs. At 50K, the gains range from 0.32% to 1.00%. Gains are larger at 5K: for example, Z-Image-Turbo improves by 3.55% at 5K versus 0.82% at 50K. On that model, the pretrained detector at 5K reaches 90.18% Avg F1, close to 90.33% for the no-distillation baseline at 20K, using a 4 × \times smaller fine-tuning pool for comparable Avg F1. This supports improved data efficiency in the tested setting. Higher Avg F1 does not imply improvement in every metric: recall or benign disturbance can worsen at individual operating points.
blocks.zh: 如图11所示,所有5个LDM的每个测试池大小的蒸馏预试改进了Avg F1. 50K时,收益率从0.32%到1.00%不等. 5K的增益较大:例如,Z-Image-Turbo在5K的增益为3.55%,而在50K的增益为0.82%. 在该型号上,5K的预训探测器达到90.18%的Avg F1,20K的不蒸发基线接近90.33%,使用4×\时的较小的微调池进行可比的Avg F1. 这有助于提高测试环境中的数据效率。 较高的Avg F1并不意味着每个度量的改善:召回或良性扰动在单个操作点会恶化.

Stars mark deployed steps s = 3 , 4 , 4 , 4 , 8 s=3,4,4,4,8 for Z/Q/H/F/I. Grey diamonds show image-detector Avg F1 after full generation; the deployed latent detectors are lower by 0.26/0.83/0.90/0.38/1.71%, respectively.

blocks.en: The per-step curves in Figure 11 show Avg F1 against the completed denoising-step fraction ( s + 1 ) / N (s{+}1)/N , where s s is zero-indexed and N N is the total number of steps. The deployed fractions are 44.4–50%, used as a denoiser-compute proxy assuming approximately uniform cost per step. The image-level baseline requires full generation for requests not already blocked by its text classifier.
blocks.zh: 图11中的每步曲线显示Avg F1与已完成的去诺化步骤分数(s+1)/N(s{+}1)/N,其中Ss为零指数化,NN为总步数. 部署的分数是44.4%-50%,作为代用计算法,假定每步费用大致一致。 图像级别基线要求对尚未被其文本分类器阻挡的请求进行全面生成.

blocks.en: Detection is already informative at the initial step and generally improves over the early denoising stages. We report deployment at step 3 for Z-Image-Turbo, step 4 for the three 10-step models, and step 8 for InternVL-U. At these steps, latent-detector Avg F1 is within 0.26–1.71% of image-level detection. If a request is intercepted there, 50–55.6% of denoising evaluations are avoided. Requests that pass the check still complete generation. These fractions exclude text encoding, SAGE’s masked re-encoding and projection, classifier inference, and VAE decoding; they do not establish a corresponding reduction in wall-clock latency or average serving cost.
blocks.zh: 发现在最初阶段已经是信息化的,在最初的取消提名阶段一般会有所改进。 我们报告Z-Image-Turbo的第3步部署,3个10步模式的第4步部署,InternVL-U的第8步部署。 在这些步骤中,潜伏探测器Avg F1在图像水平探测的0.26–1.71%范围内. 如果在那里截获请求,50-55.6%的虚名评价被避免。 要求通过检查 仍然完整的生成。 这些分数不包括文本编码、SAGE的蒙面重编码和投影、分类推论和VAE解码;它们没有规定相应减少墙时滞或平均服务费用。

blocks.en: Pretrain data generation is far faster than finetune data generation, by 48–139 × \times across all five LDMs (Table 7 ). Pretrain data requires only a single VAE encoder forward pass on existing images (roughly 100–400 ms/sample on an NVIDIA H20-3e with batch size 1 and bf16), while finetune data requires the full denoising pipeline for every prompt (roughly 5–28 s/sample). This cost asymmetry motivates our two-stage data strategy: inexpensive VAE encoding supplies large-scale feature pretraining, while generation-derived latents provide safety-specific fine-tuning data. The reported speed ratios measure sample preparation, not detector training or complete guardrail inference.

blocks.en: We compare complete guardrail systems to answer the central question: can inner guardrails, operating within the LDM’s own representation space, match or improve upon the safety–disturbance tradeoff of outer guardrails that use separate text encoders and post-hoc image filtering? blocks.en: We report two metrics. Safety rate is the fraction of all requests for which the final generated image is safe. An intercepted request counts as safe. Benign disturbance rate is measured among samples whose prompt and original, unguarded image are both safe, and counts interception or VLM-judged semantic alteration. For InGuard, disturbance can arise from direct PE-MLP interception, SAGE modification, or latent-detector interception. Prompt-risky but originally image-safe samples are excluded from this disturbance denominator by definition.

Outer guardrail : an external system composed of an mE5 text classifier for prompt-level interception and a ConvNeXt-Base image classifier fine-tuned on the 50K pool for post-hoc detection. 3. Inner guardrail (InGuard) : an in-pipeline system composed of PE-MLP for prompt-level interception, SAGE for embedding-space modification, and a ConvNeXt-Base latent detector. We select mE5 as the outer text classifier for its higher classification accuracy and lower prompt-side false alarm (Table 5 ). The comparison uses the stated routing policies and operating points: InGuard has per-LDM interception thresholds, while the outer text thresholds are porn ≥ 3 \geq 3 and gore ≥ 2 \geq 2 . blocks.en: To summarize, InGuard matches or exceeds the outer guardrail in end-to-end safety rate while offering three advantages at the reported operating points. First, benign disturbance drops from 9.3–10.6% to 2.6–4.5% (a 57.5–73.5% relative reduction). Second, InGuard uses approximately 3.7 × \times fewer added guardrail parameters ( ∼ \sim 100M vs. 370.6M). Third, when unsafe content is intercepted at the selected intermediate step, only 44.4–50% of the denoising steps have been consumed, allowing the remaining steps to be skipped rather than completing generation for a post-hoc image check.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: In this work, we propose InGuard, an in-pipeline safety framework for text-to-image generation, which works inside the pipeline and operates on the model’s own representations. It has three components that act at different stages: PE-MLP grades each prompt on the text encoder’s embeddings, SAGE modifies the embeddings of risky prompts, and a latent detector checks an intermediate one-step clean latent estimate. All three components leave the base-model parameters untouched, and only the guardrail classifiers are adapted to each backend. We also construct the RevGen Safety Benchmark, a suite of 10,000 prompts that are reverse-generated from real images. It covers porn, gore, and controlled IP risks, and provides graded severity for porn and gore, categorical labels for IP, and benign negatives near the decision boundary. Experiments across five open-weight LDMs show that InGuard reaches a 97.9–98.8% safety rate, matching or exceeding the outer guardrail, while reducing benign disturbance by 57.5–73.5% with approximately 3.7 × \times fewer added parameters. When a request is intercepted at the selected intermediate step, it also avoids 50–55.6% of the denoising steps.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出InGuard,这是一个文本到图像生成的内管安全框架,在管道内工作,并使用模型本身的表示。 它有三个在不同阶段起作用的成分:PE-MLP在文本编码器的嵌入上每分级,SAGE修改了风险提示的嵌入,以及一个潜伏的探测器检查中间一步的清洁潜值。 所有三个组件都留下了基建模型参数未动,只有护栏分类器可以适应每个后端. 我们还建造了RevGen安全基准,这是一套由真实图像逆向生成的10 000个提示。 它涵盖了色情, gore, 以及控制IP风险, 并提供了色情和gore的分级严重性, IP的断然标签, 5个开放式LDM的实验显示,InGuard达到97.9-98.8%的安全率,匹配或超过外护栏,同时将良性扰动减少57.5-73.5 %,增加的参数大约为3.7×xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 当请求在选定的中间步骤被拦截时,它也避免50-55.6%的去名步骤.

blocks.en: These results also point to several directions for future work. First, the label-gated design ties SAGE to the accuracy of the prompt classifier and to a finite concept set. Making it more robust to adversarial rewriting and to multi-character IP scenes is therefore an important next step. Second, our evaluation covers three risk categories, namely porn, gore, and IP. Other policy dimensions, such as hate and privacy, remain to be explored. Third, our detection relies on the one-step latent estimate. As new open-weight generators and modalities keep appearing, extending it to unseen generators, to video generation, and to other iterative synthesis processes would let safety coverage keep pace with these models, which is a promising direction for further study.
blocks.zh: 这些结果也为今后的工作指明了几个方向。 首先,标签式设计将SAGE与即时分类器的准确性以及一个有限的概念集联系起来. 因此,使它更有力地进行对抗性重写和多特征的IP场景是下一步的一个重要步骤。 第二,我们的评价包括三个风险类别,即色情、戈尔和知识产权。 仇恨和隐私等其他政策层面仍有待探讨。 第三,我们的探测依赖于一步潜伏的估计。 随着新的开放重量发电机和模式不断出现,将其扩展到看不见的发电机、视频生成和其他迭代合成过程,安全覆盖将跟上这些模式,这是进一步研究的一个很有希望的方向。

blocks.en: 7 Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 7 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies safety mechanisms for text-to-image generation, and it necessarily involves sensitive material, including NSFW content and controlled IP characters. Our goal is to reduce the risk of misuse of open-weight generators, not to facilitate the creation of harmful or infringing content.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了文本到图像生成的安全机制,它必然涉及敏感的材料,包括NSFW的内容和受控制的IP字符. 我们的目标是减少滥用露天发电机的风险,而不是为制造有害或侵权内容提供便利。

blocks.en: The RevGen Safety Benchmark is built for research on safety evaluation. We release only text prompts and their risk labels, and we do not release the source images or any generated unsafe images. Controlled IP characters are used only to evaluate policy compliance and are not intended to endorse or enable copyright infringement. Sensitive examples shown in the paper are included solely to illustrate the studied risks. We intend the benchmark and the InGuard framework to support defensive safety research and responsible deployment, and we discourage any use of these resources to generate, distribute, or promote unsafe or infringing content.
blocks.zh: RevGen安全基准是为安全评价研究而制订的。 我们只发布文本提示及其风险标签,我们不发布源图像或任何生成的不安全图像. 受控IP字符仅用于评价政策合规性,无意认可或促成版权侵权. 文件所列敏感的例子只是为了说明所研究的风险。 我们打算制定基准和《英盖德框架》,以支持防御性安全研究和负责任的部署,我们劝阻使用这些资源产生、分配或推广不安全或侵权内容。

blocks.en: The prompt risk levels (Section 3 ) use a six-level scale for porn and gore and an eight-level scale for IP: • Pornographic ( 0 0 – 5 5 ): 0 0 safe; 1 1 mild suggestion (e.g., romantic but non-sexual scenarios); 2 2 suggestive attire or pose (e.g., generic “sexy” descriptors, regular swimwear); 3 3 strong suggestive (e.g., lingerie, see-through fabric, strongly suggestive poses); 4 4 near-explicit (e.g., nipple-emphasizing descriptions without nudity); 5 5 explicit (e.g., sexual acts, full nudity, CSAM). • Violence & gore ( 0 0 – 5 5 ): 0 0 safe; 1 1 violent action (e.g., fighting, weapon attack posture) without described harm; 2 2 violent with harm (e.g., stabbing, torture, war) but without blood; 3 3 mild tension (e.g., dark atmosphere, dangerous objects without harmful action); 4 4 bloody / gore suggestion (e.g., visible wounds with bleeding); 5 5 extreme gore (e.g., dismemberment, exposed organs, corpses, skeletal remains). blocks.en: The image-grounded labels used by the metric definitions above operate on the generated image: judgments are based strictly on visible content, textual overlays cannot trigger a hit, and ambiguous cases (blur, occlusion, low resolution) default to benign. blocks.en: Although the labels are collected at this finer granularity, evaluation consumes them as binary ground truth: an image counts as unsafe only when pornographic = 2 =2 or violence-gore = 2 =2 or the IP label falls in [ 1 , 5 ] [1,5] . Borderline porn/gore (level 1 1 ) and associated IP (level 6 6 ) are treated as safe. The finer scale exists for annotation accuracy: separating borderline from explicit content, and associated from controlled characters, forces the annotator to resolve ambiguous cases explicitly rather than collapsing them into a single risky class. A manual audit of roughly 1,000 labeled images found the annotation accuracy to be consistently above 98%, so we treat this ground truth as reliable.
blocks.zh: 虽然标签被收集在这个更细微的颗粒度上,但评价将其消耗为二进制地面真理:只有当色情=2=2或者暴力-gore=2=2或者IP标签掉入[1,5][1,5]时,图像才算作不安全. 边线色情/视线(一级1)和相关IP(6级6)被视为安全. 更精细的尺度是为了说明准确性而存在的:将分界线与明确的内容区分开来,并与受控字符相关联,迫使注释者明确解决模棱两可的案件,而不是将它们分解成一个单一的风险类别。 对大约1000幅标注的图像进行人工审核后发现,注解精度始终高于98%,所以我们把这种地面真理视为可靠.

blocks.en: ConvNeXt beats ViT at every pool size, reaching 91.4–92.1% Avg F1 versus 85.0–85.4% at 50K without distillation, though ViT also lags in the RGB configuration, so this is not a latent-specific effect. Distillation at 50K adds 5.38–6.23% Avg F1 for ViT and 0.82–1.25% for ConvNeXt, and within the distilled ConvNeXt family Avg F1 spans only 92.66% (Tiny) to 93.19% (Large). We select Base (92.87% Avg F1, 88.6M parameters) over Large (198M) as a recall-oriented choice: relative to Tiny it trades higher risk recall (95.59% vs. 92.45%) for higher disturbance (9.40% vs. 6.18%), rather than being uniformly best.
